messages.text: How do changes in AI data centers technology affect the measurement capability required from Signaling / Non-signaling Tester?

The measurement implication that can be supported is indirect: wireless testers need to handle higher-throughput, wider-bandwidth, multi-RF-chain, multi-technology, signaling and non-signaling test cases that are already described for Wi‑Fi 7 / emerging Wi‑Fi 8, 5G NR, MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER/BLER, fading and IP/application testing [1][9][21][35][36][40].
### AI data center technology trends that matter to test capability
AI data centers are described as infrastructure for large language models, generative AI and cloud computing, with core elements including high-performance AI servers, GPU/TPU, liquid cooling systems and high-speed networks [1].
The ecosystem map further breaks AI data center infrastructure into cloud service, datacenter, AI server, power, cooling, security, compute and peripheral categories [10].
In compute, the map lists IP core, CPU, GPU and special AI chips [6].
In peripherals, it lists HDD, SSD, power, PMIC, PCB, high-speed connection, optical module and switch categories [9].
### Measurement capability implications for signaling testers such as CMX500
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing that supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [21].
Its documented capabilities include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements across 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be and 802.11bn with 2x2 MIMO [21].
It also supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI scripting, Python XLAPI and SCPI remote control [21].
For Wi‑Fi 7 R&D, CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality, intended to test wireless device operation across cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards in a single-instrument setup [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is stated to require signaling-mode and real-world-condition measurements of RF TX/RX characteristics, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high data throughput, tens of gigabits per second, low latency, 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM and MLO [40].
CMX500 callbox material also describes high end-to-end throughput testing, including 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2 and 10 Gbps E2E testing [29].
### Measurement capability implications for non-signaling testers such as CMP180
For WLAN device production, RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose [36].
CMP180 supports cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [36].
CMP180 is also described as validating a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode, where that waveform is a potential candidate for not-yet-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [36].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO testing in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [36].
### Implications for CMW
CMW500 is documented as a wideband radio communication tester, with supported configurations covering 40/80 MHz bandwidth units and 160 MHz bandwidth units [51].
Its hardware options include ARB memory options and a 160 MHz bandwidth ARB-included option, and data application units up to 4000 Mbit with Ethernet 1 Gbps/10 Gbps and USB 3.0 [49].
The CMW500 data-sheet summary says it lists many GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, Bluetooth, GPS, DVB, FM stereo, WLAN, LR-WPAN, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000 and NR analyzer software options [54].
### Product-to-capability view
| Product line | Measurement capability affected by newer AI-data-center-adjacent connectivity trends | Knowledge-base confirmed capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| CMX500 | More need for signaling tests across cellular + WLAN, high throughput, MIMO, interference/desense, real-world channel conditions and IP/application behavior | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn, 2x2 MIMO, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI, throughput, PER, IP traffic analysis and application testing | [21] |
| CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D requires signaling-mode RF TX/RX under real-world conditions and multiple RF chains for MLO | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in one setup; Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E tests | [35] |
| CMP180 | Production shifts toward faster non-signaling RF verification for wideband WLAN/NR devices | Non-signaling production RF testing, Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz | [36] |
| CMP180 | More RF chains and wider channels increase need for scalable MIMO and wideband analyzer/generator resources | Two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO; two instruments scalable to 4x4 MIMO; 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185; WLAN 802.11be 320 MHz analyzer/generator performance; WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 options | [36][43][45][46] |
### 【推論】Practical impact
【推論】Because AI data centers are characterized by high-speed networking and peripherals such as high-speed connections, optical modules and switches, while modern wireless test passages emphasize Wi‑Fi 7/8-class bandwidth, MIMO, high throughput and multi-technology operation, tester capability discussions should focus less on basic connectivity and more on wide bandwidth, multi-port/MIMO, high-throughput, coexistence/desense and automation-ready signaling/non-signaling workflows.[1][9][21][35][36][40]
【推論】CMX500 is the better-supported signaling-side fit in the provided evidence because the passages explicitly connect it to 5G NR, WLAN 802.11be/802.11bn, signaling, throughput, PER/BLER, fading, IP/application tests, Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and cellular/WLAN interworking, while CMP180 is the better-supported non-signaling-side fit because the passages explicitly connect it to production non-signaling RF tests, 500 MHz bandwidth, 8 GHz range and scalable MIMO.[21][35][36][38][45][46]

The measurement implication that can be supported is indirect: wireless testers need to handle higher-throughput, wider-bandwidth, multi-RF-chain, multi-technology, signaling and non-signaling test cases that are already described for Wi‑Fi 7 / emerging Wi‑Fi 8, 5G NR, MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER/BLER, fading and IP/application testing [1][9][21][35][36][40].
### AI data center technology trends that matter to test capability
AI data centers are described as infrastructure for large language models, generative AI and cloud computing, with core elements including high-performance AI servers, GPU/TPU, liquid cooling systems and high-speed networks [1].
The ecosystem map further breaks AI data center infrastructure into cloud service, datacenter, AI server, power, cooling, security, compute and peripheral categories [10].
In compute, the map lists IP core, CPU, GPU and special AI chips [6].
In peripherals, it lists HDD, SSD, power, PMIC, PCB, high-speed connection, optical module and switch categories [9].
### Measurement capability implications for signaling testers such as CMX500
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing that supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [21].
Its documented capabilities include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements across 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be and 802.11bn with 2x2 MIMO [21].
It also supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI scripting, Python XLAPI and SCPI remote control [21].
For Wi‑Fi 7 R&D, CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality, intended to test wireless device operation across cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards in a single-instrument setup [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is stated to require signaling-mode and real-world-condition measurements of RF TX/RX characteristics, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high data throughput, tens of gigabits per second, low latency, 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM and MLO [40].
CMX500 callbox material also describes high end-to-end throughput testing, including 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2 and 10 Gbps E2E testing [29].
### Measurement capability implications for non-signaling testers such as CMP180
For WLAN device production, RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose [36].
CMP180 supports cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [36].
CMP180 is also described as validating a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode, where that waveform is a potential candidate for not-yet-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [36].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO testing in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [36].
### Implications for CMW
CMW500 is documented as a wideband radio communication tester, with supported configurations covering 40/80 MHz bandwidth units and 160 MHz bandwidth units [51].
Its hardware options include ARB memory options and a 160 MHz bandwidth ARB-included option, and data application units up to 4000 Mbit with Ethernet 1 Gbps/10 Gbps and USB 3.0 [49].
The CMW500 data-sheet summary says it lists many GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, Bluetooth, GPS, DVB, FM stereo, WLAN, LR-WPAN, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000 and NR analyzer software options [54].
### Product-to-capability view
| Product line | Measurement capability affected by newer AI-data-center-adjacent connectivity trends | Knowledge-base confirmed capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| CMX500 | More need for signaling tests across cellular + WLAN, high throughput, MIMO, interference/desense, real-world channel conditions and IP/application behavior | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn, 2x2 MIMO, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI, throughput, PER, IP traffic analysis and application testing | [21] |
| CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D requires signaling-mode RF TX/RX under real-world conditions and multiple RF chains for MLO | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in one setup; Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E tests | [35] |
| CMP180 | Production shifts toward faster non-signaling RF verification for wideband WLAN/NR devices | Non-signaling production RF testing, Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz | [36] |
| CMP180 | More RF chains and wider channels increase need for scalable MIMO and wideband analyzer/generator resources | Two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO; two instruments scalable to 4x4 MIMO; 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185; WLAN 802.11be 320 MHz analyzer/generator performance; WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 options | [36][43][45][46] |
### 【推論】Practical impact
【推論】Because AI data centers are characterized by high-speed networking and peripherals such as high-speed connections, optical modules and switches, while modern wireless test passages emphasize Wi‑Fi 7/8-class bandwidth, MIMO, high throughput and multi-technology operation, tester capability discussions should focus less on basic connectivity and more on wide bandwidth, multi-port/MIMO, high-throughput, coexistence/desense and automation-ready signaling/non-signaling workflows.[1][9][21][35][36][40]
【推論】CMX500 is the better-supported signaling-side fit in the provided evidence because the passages explicitly connect it to 5G NR, WLAN 802.11be/802.11bn, signaling, throughput, PER/BLER, fading, IP/application tests, Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and cellular/WLAN interworking, while CMP180 is the better-supported non-signaling-side fit because the passages explicitly connect it to production non-signaling RF tests, 500 MHz bandwidth, 8 GHz range and scalable MIMO.[21][35][36][38][45][46]

The measurement implication that can be supported is indirect: wireless testers need to handle higher-throughput, wider-bandwidth, multi-RF-chain, multi-technology, signaling and non-signaling test cases that are already described for Wi‑Fi 7 / emerging Wi‑Fi 8, 5G NR, MIMO, coexistence, throughput, PER/BLER, fading and IP/application testing [1][9][21][35][36][40].
### AI data center technology trends that matter to test capability
AI data centers are described as infrastructure for large language models, generative AI and cloud computing, with core elements including high-performance AI servers, GPU/TPU, liquid cooling systems and high-speed networks [1].
The ecosystem map further breaks AI data center infrastructure into cloud service, datacenter, AI server, power, cooling, security, compute and peripheral categories [10].
In compute, the map lists IP core, CPU, GPU and special AI chips [6].
In peripherals, it lists HDD, SSD, power, PMIC, PCB, high-speed connection, optical module and switch categories [9].
### Measurement capability implications for signaling testers such as CMX500
CMX500 is a universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution for device testing that supports LTE, NR FR1, NR FR2, NSA, SA, FDD and TDD [21].
Its documented capabilities include NR FR1/FR2 signaling and TX measurements, LTE signaling, NB-IoT/NB-NTN signaling, WLAN signaling and WLAN TX measurements across 802.11a/b/g/n/ac, 802.11ax, 802.11be and 802.11bn with 2x2 MIMO [21].
It also supports fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI report, throughput measurement, PER measurement, application test, IP traffic analysis, IMS/audio/POLQA, GUI scripting, Python XLAPI and SCPI remote control [21].
For Wi‑Fi 7 R&D, CMX500 is positioned as a multi-technology, multi-channel signaling tester with integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality, intended to test wireless device operation across cellular and non-cellular latest-generation standards in a single-instrument setup [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 R&D testing is stated to require signaling-mode and real-world-condition measurements of RF TX/RX characteristics, and MLO makes a multiple-RF-chain test environment important [35].
Wi‑Fi 7 is described as targeting extremely high data throughput, tens of gigabits per second, low latency, 320 MHz channel bandwidth, up to 16 spatial streams, 4096 QAM and MLO [40].
CMX500 callbox material also describes high end-to-end throughput testing, including 1024 DL QAM in FR1, 10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified, 1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2 and 10 Gbps E2E testing [29].
### Measurement capability implications for non-signaling testers such as CMP180
For WLAN device production, RF measurements are described as being performed in non-signaling mode to save time, and CMP180 is positioned as optimized for this production non-signaling RF testing purpose [36].
CMP180 supports cellular and non-cellular technologies including Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7 and 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, with bandwidths up to 500 MHz [36].
CMP180 is also described as validating a 480 MHz WLAN waveform in loopback mode, where that waveform is a potential candidate for not-yet-defined Wi‑Fi 8 / IEEE 802.11bn, not a formal Wi‑Fi 8 specification [36].
CMP180 integrates two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO testing in one box, and two CMP180 instruments can be combined to support four analyzers and generators for 4x4 MIMO access-point testing [36].
### Implications for CMW
CMW500 is documented as a wideband radio communication tester, with supported configurations covering 40/80 MHz bandwidth units and 160 MHz bandwidth units [51].
Its hardware options include ARB memory options and a 160 MHz bandwidth ARB-included option, and data application units up to 4000 Mbit with Ethernet 1 Gbps/10 Gbps and USB 3.0 [49].
The CMW500 data-sheet summary says it lists many GSM, NB-IoT, WCDMA, LTE, Bluetooth, GPS, DVB, FM stereo, WLAN, LR-WPAN, TD-SCDMA, CDMA2000 and NR analyzer software options [54].
### Product-to-capability view
| Product line | Measurement capability affected by newer AI-data-center-adjacent connectivity trends | Knowledge-base confirmed capability | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| CMX500 | More need for signaling tests across cellular + WLAN, high throughput, MIMO, interference/desense, real-world channel conditions and IP/application behavior | LTE, NR FR1/FR2, WLAN 802.11a/b/g/n/ac/ax/be/bn, 2x2 MIMO, fading, AWGN, BLER, CSI, throughput, PER, IP traffic analysis and application testing | [21] |
| CMX500 | Wi‑Fi 7 R&D requires signaling-mode RF TX/RX under real-world conditions and multiple RF chains for MLO | Integrated Wi‑Fi 7 test functionality for testing cellular and non-cellular standards in one setup; Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests include 2x2 MIMO, 6 GHz out-of-band discovery, coexistence and E2E tests | [35] |
| CMP180 | Production shifts toward faster non-signaling RF verification for wideband WLAN/NR devices | Non-signaling production RF testing, Wi‑Fi 6E, Wi‑Fi 7, 5G NR FR1 up to 8 GHz, bandwidths up to 500 MHz | [36] |
| CMP180 | More RF chains and wider channels increase need for scalable MIMO and wideband analyzer/generator resources | Two analyzers, two generators, two sets of eight RF ports for 2x2 MIMO; two instruments scalable to 4x4 MIMO; 500 MHz IF bandwidth with R&S CMP-K185; WLAN 802.11be 320 MHz analyzer/generator performance; WLAN true MIMO 2x2/4x4 and 5x5/6x6 options | [36][43][45][46] |
### 【推論】Practical impact
【推論】Because AI data centers are characterized by high-speed networking and peripherals such as high-speed connections, optical modules and switches, while modern wireless test passages emphasize Wi‑Fi 7/8-class bandwidth, MIMO, high throughput and multi-technology operation, tester capability discussions should focus less on basic connectivity and more on wide bandwidth, multi-port/MIMO, high-throughput, coexistence/desense and automation-ready signaling/non-signaling workflows.[1][9][21][35][36][40]
【推論】CMX500 is the better-supported signaling-side fit in the provided evidence because the passages explicitly connect it to 5G NR, WLAN 802.11be/802.11bn, signaling, throughput, PER/BLER, fading, IP/application tests, Wi‑Fi 7 R&D and cellular/WLAN interworking, while CMP180 is the better-supported non-signaling-side fit because the passages explicitly connect it to production non-signaling RF tests, 500 MHz bandwidth, 8 GHz range and scalable MIMO.[21][35][36][38][45][46]

R&S CMX500 › 產品定位
依 [[CMX500_specs_en_5216-4127-22_v1100]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 是 universal one-box network emulation and measurement test solution，支援最新 3GPP [[5G NR]] technology，適用於 device testing，涵蓋 [[LTE]]、[[NR FR1]]、[[NR FR2]]，並支援 non-standalone（NSA）、standalone（SA）、FDD 與 TDD。

依 [[CMX500_Features_CSW9-20-0_en_32]]，[[R&S CMX500]] 也提供：

- [[NR FR1]] / [[NR FR2]] signaling 與 TX measurements。
- [[LTE]] signaling、LTE-DTC / direct-to-cell communication、LTE measurements。
- [[NB-IoT]] / NB-NTN signaling。
- [[WLAN]] signaling 與 WLAN TX measurements，涵蓋 802.11a/b/g/n/ac、802.11ax、802.11be、802.11bn 與 2x2 MIMO。
- [[Fading]]、[[AWGN]]、[[BLER]]、[[CSI report]]、[[Throughput measurement]]、[[PER measurement]]。
- Application test、IP traffic analysis、IMS / audio / [[POLQA]]。
- GUI、graphical scripting、Python-based [[XLAPI]] 與 [[SCPI]] remote control。

CMX500_Callbox › 重點摘要
- High end-to-end throughput 部分稱 1024 DL QAM available in FR1、10.6 Gbps with 5CC SA verified、1CC FR1 + 8CC FR2、10 Gbps E2E testing，並列出 [[R&S CMX-KS610B]]、[[R&S CMX-KS637B]] 與 [[R&S CMX-KA100]]。
- Non-signaling / GPRF 部分稱 GPRF Generator signal types 包含 ARB、CW、Dual Tone、Replay `.wv` files、up to 4 GPRF Generator instances in parallel、ARB Sequencer，且標示 no license required；但 technology-specific R&S provided ARB files 與 WinIQSim2 waveforms 由 KWxxx licenses enable。
- GPRF / ARB file 部分列出 KW libraries：GNSS [[R&S CMX-KW220]]、BT [[R&S CMX-KW310]]、WLAN KW350/KW351/KW352/KW353、GSM KW420、WCDMA KW440、LTE KW500、NB-IoT KW250、LTE C-V2X KW570、NR Rel 15/16 KW601、NR Rel 17 KW602 + KW601、NR C-V2X KW670、AWGN KW120；另有 [[R&S CMX-KW101]] Create ARB on CMX，coming with CSW 9.10。
- IQ recorder 部分稱可 record up to 4 Gbyte to a file、save files as `.wv` for replay、使用 same IQ stream + RF parameters as signaling、2 per RFU、1 per IFU、FR1 specialist 可 8 instances in parallel。
- Standalone TX measurements 部分列出 [[R&S CMX-KM500]] LTE Measurements 與 [[R&S CMX-KM600]] NR FR1 Measurements, Single Carrier。
- QDART support 部分稱 CMX500 officially listed for 5G Sub-6 / 2G–4G，WLAN internally verified and currently in process to get listed in Qualcomm help files。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › R&D：R&S CMX500 single-box signaling testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- [[R&S CMX500]] 是 multi-technology multi-channel signaling tester。
- 來源稱其已新增 integrated [[Wi-Fi 7]] test functionality。
- 目的在 single instrument setup 中測試 wireless device 在 cellular 與 non-cellular latest-generation standards 下的 operation。
- Wi-Fi 7 R&D 測試需在 signaling mode 與 real-world conditions 下量測 RF TX / RX characteristics。
- [[MLO]] 是 [[Wi-Fi 7]] key feature，因此提供 multiple RF chains 的 test environment 很重要。
- 來源列出的 Wi‑Fi 7-specific tests 包含 2x2 [[MIMO]]、6 GHz band with out-of-band discovery、coexistence 與 E2E test capabilities。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Production：R&S CMP180 non-signaling RF testing
依 [[Rohde & Schwarz presents its Wi-Fi 7 multi-channel single-box test solutions for R&D and production at MWC 2024]]：

- WLAN device production phase 中，所有 RF measurements 以 non-signaling mode 執行以節省時間。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 被定位為 optimized for this purpose 的 radio communication tester。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] 支援 many cellular and non-cellular technologies，包括 [[Wi-Fi 6E]]、[[Wi-Fi 7]] 與 [[5G NR FR1]] up to 8 GHz，bandwidths up to 500 MHz。
- [[R&S CMP180]] 將展示 loopback mode 驗證 **480 MHz bandwidth** 的 [[WLAN]] waveform。
- 來源稱 480 MHz WLAN waveform 是 yet-to-be-defined [[Wi-Fi 8]] / [[IEEE 802.11bn]] 的 potential waveform candidate；這不是正式 Wi‑Fi 8 規格。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMP180]] integrated two analyzers, two generators and two sets of eight RF ports，可在 single box 支援 2x2 [[MIMO]] testing。
- 來源稱 two [[R&S CMP180]] instruments can be combined and scaled to support four analyzers and generators for efficient testing of 4x4 [[MIMO]] access points。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Interworking：WLAN offloading 與 Voice over WLAN
同一來源也把 [[R&S CMX500]] 用於 cellular [[5G]] 與 [[WLAN]] 的 seamless traffic offloading and interworking demonstration：

- [[WLAN offloading]] 是把原本 intended for cellular networks 的 data 透過 WLAN 傳送，以減少 cellular bands data load。
- [[Voice over WLAN]] 情境聚焦在 cellular network 與 WLAN 之間 handover during a voice call，以維持 uninterrupted voice call experience。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 內建 newly integrated [[N3IWF]] gateway，可測試 WLAN offloading with Voice over WLAN。
- 來源稱 [[R&S CMX500]] 的 integrated [[POLQA]] voice quality measurement function 可用於 voice over WLAN applications 的 quality of experience early-stage 評估。

Wi-Fi 7 R&D and production testing › Wi-Fi 7 技術挑戰
來源將 [[Wi-Fi 7]] / [[IEEE 802.11be]] 描述為 designed for extremely high data throughput，面向 tens of gigabits per second、low latency、ultra-high-definition video streaming、virtual reality 與 augmented reality applications。來源列出的 higher throughput key elements：

| 技術項目 | 來源說法 |
|---|---|
| channel bandwidth | increased channel bandwidth of 320 MHz |
| spatial streams | up to 16 spatial streams |
| modulation | 4096 QAM modulation |
| MLO | key feature；使 multiple RF chains 測試環境變重要 |
